description.value:
The void pulls you toward wounded prey.

Effect Stride toward the nearest enemy that is below half its maximum Hit Points, ignoring difficult terrain. If you end your movement adjacent to it, your next Strike against it this turn gains a +1 circumstance bonus to the attack roll.

In an encounter, you can't use this ability again for [[/gmr 1d6 #Recharge this ability]]{1d6 rounds}. Out of combat there is no cooldown.
